remarks: Move right in and enjoy this bright, welcoming four-level home offering two bedrooms and two and a half baths. Sunlight fills each level, highlighting gleaming wood floors, beautifully updated bathrooms, and an eat-in kitchen with stainless steel appliances that's ready for everyday living and easy entertaining.  The living room feels both inviting and refined, centered around the wood-burning fireplace with a sleek gray marble hearth. Upstairs, the primary suite is a peaceful retreat with a soaring cathedral ceiling and a marble bath featuring a double vanity and a spacious walk-in shower. Spacious 2nd bedroom, full marble bath, and stacked W/D complete the 2nd floor.  The third-floor loft is filled with natural light and offers flexible space ideal for a home office, den, or exercise area. On the lower level, you'll find space perfect for a mudroom, recreation area, or workspace, along with direct access to a generous two-car garage.  Set within the desirable Gazebo complex, this turnkey home offers easy access to downtown Stamford, Stamford Hospital Tully Health Center, the Ferguson library, popular dining, and convenient shopping. With the Glenbrook Metro-North station under a mile away and Stamford Station less than two miles away, this home delivers comfort, convenience, and an easy, low-maintenance lifestyle. Available for rent or to own, you don't want to miss the chance to make 132 Hope Street, C, your home.
